in_marathi.name: Hemanth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Hem’, meaning sun. Hemanth is a name that signifies the radiance and brilliance of the sun, representing power, strength, and vitality.
